en.judul: Will the Lamp at Home Light?
en.instruksi: Read how each gadget's circuit is set up. Predict whether its lamp lights up or not.
en.i-senteron: torch: batteries in, switch slid to ON
en.i-mobilon: toy car: wires unbroken, switch ON
en.i-lenteraon: battery lantern: all wires connected, switch closed
en.i-mejaon: circuit on the table: a loose wire is tightened so it is complete again
en.i-pisauon: circuit on the table: the knife switch is pressed down to touch (closed)
en.i-senteroff: torch: switch slid to OFF (switch open)
en.i-mobilputus: toy car: a wire inside is broken
en.i-lenterakosong: battery lantern: the batteries are taken out
en.i-mejalepas: circuit on the table: one wire clip has come off the lamp
en.i-pisauoff: circuit on the table: the knife switch is lifted (open)
